title: Beyond Experience: Knowledge-Guided Evolution for NPU Kernel Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.27588v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents have become capable kernel engineers on mainstream GPU stacks, but they struggle on emerging accelerators such as Ascend NPUs, whose programming model is barely represented in pretraining data. Recent NPU agents address this gap largely through experience: they accumulate memory from their own generation and optimization trials and reuse it on later tasks. We argue that experience alone is not enough for kernel generation. An agent can only remember what it has tried, and it rarely tries a mechanism it does not know. As a result, such memory offers little help when a new operator calls for a different mechanism, and even familiar operators raise unseen situations as optimization proceeds. We present ASCENDEVOLVE, which grounds every step of an evolutionary kernel search in a large external knowledge base built from platform documentation, toolkit headers, and operator repositories. translated_title: 超越经验：面向NPU核函数生成的知识引导进化方法
translated_abstract: LLM智能体已成为主流GPU技术栈上能力出色的核函数工程师，但它们在昇腾NPU等新兴加速器上却表现不佳，因为此类硬件的编程模型在预训练数据中几乎未被涵盖。近期面向NPU的智能体主要通过“经验”来弥补这一差距：它们从自身的生成与优化尝试中积累记忆，并在后续任务中加以复用。我们认为，仅凭经验不足以完成核函数生成任务：智能体只能记住自己尝试过的东西，而它很少会去尝试自己并不了解的机制。因此，当新算子需要采用不同机制时，这类记忆帮助甚微；即使是对熟悉的算子，随着优化的深入也会不断出现未曾见过的情形。我们提出ASCENDEVOLVE，它将进化式核函数搜索的每一步都建立在一个大型外部知识库之上，该知识库由平台文档、工具码头文件和算子代码仓库构建而成。由于该语料库的规模远超任何上下文窗口所能容纳的范围……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出ASCENDEVOLVE框架，将基于平台文档、工具码头文件和算子仓库构建的大型外部知识库引入进化式核函数搜索的每一步，以克服仅靠智能体自身经验难以应对昇腾NPU等新兴加速器上核函数生成与优化挑战的局限。
en_tdlr: ASCENDEVOLVE grounds every step of an evolutionary kernel search on emerging NPUs in a large external knowledge base built from platform documentation, toolkit headers, and operator repositories, overcoming the limitations of experience-only agent memory.
